sites.title: Websites
sites.description: Domains or URLs, one per line. Up to 20,000 per run.

extraPaths.title: Extra paths to test
extraPaths.description: Optional paths besides the home page, e.g. /blog/ or /products/. Each bot's access is reported per path.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel sites
maxConcurrency.description: How many sites are checked in parallel (2 small requests per site).
